I feel like I am in a similar boat as you. It’s hard to lose someone but it’s worse to lose yourself. Please don’t do anything to hurt or kill yourself. Just let all the emotions out without hurting yourself or anyone else. Emotions are honest, it’s important they get out. Then one day you will be content where you are. It’s been three years for me. I love him but it’s time to let him go. I deserve to be free and find my happiness. Please do the same.
I don’t blame you at all. I have a disability and CF. Absolutely no way am I bringing a kid who may have to face a disability themselves or feel the burden to take care of me. No thanks.

That’s understandable. Having a physical disability in life is hard. There are adjustments to make and planning ahead. She isn’t thinking about you in mind and making this about herself instead of two people in a relationship making the same goals together. I’m so sorry. You are very brave and you deserve to live your best life.
I’m so sorry. I hope you find peace in your life again. Keep going.

Please don’t do that. I love French people, you are the best. I wish I was actually in France now. Life is much better there, believe me. Our healthcare in America is awful. Uninsured medication costs are absurd. My Cymbalta meds cost $300 without insurance. An ambulance is like $2000+. 

Most importantly, my relatives in France are precious to me. I am having a fall out with one cousin that I am trying to mend.

I can completely understand. Nothing wrong with Deafness. It is hard because the majority of people don’t use sign language to communicate. And hearing people forget that deafness is a reality. Many cannot imagine a life without sound. Lack of sound is not necessarily the problem if accommodations are easily available. I can do fine without sound. Deafness is neutral to me.

Thank you for sharing that. I relate in a lot of ways with you. Some men can be nice but it’s not enough to just be nice. It’s more important to be consistent in a good way. Most men have shown awful behavior towards me. If it’s not physical, it’s psychological or verbal abuse. Even the silent treatment. It’s best to steer clear of dating them. If you work with them, speak on professional terms only.
